subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: I almost removed this from the app. Then one user's story changed everything. This is what she discovered.
body_paragraphs: Sarah almost deleted Fresh Start after week two. Said it wasn't working. The AI therapist felt generic. The journaling felt forced. She was about to give up and go back to stalking his Instagram at 3AM. Then she tapped something by accident.

She told me later it was like finding a secret room in a house you've lived in for years. The obsessive thoughts about her ex? They didn't just get quieter. They started to lose their power. Her identity wasn't just 'the person who got dumped' anymore. She could finally see herself as someone new.

The feature she found? It's buried in the 'Progress' tab. Most people just glance at their mood chart and leave. But if you tap and hold on any low point on your graph for 3 seconds, it unlocks 'Pattern Analysis'. The app doesn't just track your mood. It learns the exact triggers, times of day, and thought loops that pull you backward. Then it builds a custom defense for each one.

Tap your lowest point on your mood chart right now. Hold it. See what the app has already learned about your heartbreak patterns. It takes 30 seconds. Do it before your next spiral hits. P.S. Sarah's now 87 days no-contact. She didn't just move on. She upgraded.
